name: barbaro
description: Local coordination for Codex and Claude Code sessions
author: David Kim

scripts.clean:dist: node -e "const path=require('node:path');const target=path.resolve('dist');if(path.dirname(target)!==process.cwd()||path.basename(target)!=='dist')throw new Error('refusing to clean unexpected output path');require('node:fs').rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.fixtures:regenerate: npm run build && node scripts/regenerate-claude-expected.mjs && node scripts/regenerate-codex-expected.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run check:release && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && npm run build:package && node scripts/generate-readme-assets.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run build && find dist/test -type f -name '*.test.js' -print0 | xargs -0 node --test
